# Epigram

> AI-powered news in short for busy people. Epigram is an open-source news
> reader that fetches stories from Mediastack and Exa, summarizes them with
> OpenAI (gpt-4o-mini) via the Vercel AI SDK, and presents a fast,
> topic-organized reading feed.

Dummy placeholder file (llms-full.txt). Replace with the full generated
llms.txt content for this site.

## Optional

- [AI Insights API](/api/news/ai-insights): Optional deeper AI analysis of an individual story.
- [News Populate API](/api/news/populate): Scheduled news ingestion endpoint (protected by a secret header).
